newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's 3-yr bond yields end slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's 3-yr bond yields end slightly higher.

text.p: Yields on benchmark three-year corporate bonds closed slightly higher on Monday as banks were inactive ahead of Tuesday's deadline for the central bank's review of reserve levels, dealers said.
Three-month CD yields closed lower due to scanty new issues amid low cash demand from companies, they said.
* 3-yr corporates close at 12.45 pct vs Saturday's 12.42
* 3-mth CDs end at 12.80 pct vs Saturday's 12.91
* Average overnight call rate at 11.3 pct vs Saturday's 10.8
